title: Two-sided CDF comparison bounds Lévy distance
statement: For finite measures $mu$ and $nu$ on $bbr$, define their Lévy distance as the infimum of all $deltage0$ such that, for every $uinbbr$, $(nu((-infty,u-delta]).toReal-delta)lemu((-infty,u]).toReal$ and $mu((-infty,u]).toReallenu((-infty,u+delta]).toReal+delta$. Suppose $w,ege0$ and, for every real $u$, each of the two measures' CDF values at $u$ is at most the other's CDF value at $u+w$ plus $e$. Then the Lévy distance from $mu$ to $nu$ is at most $w+e$.
